_about: Every text layer, pinned. tools/fetch_sources.py downloads each file and refuses it unless the SHA-256 matches. MACULA files are pinned to a git commit, so they never change. eBible files are regenerated over time; if a hash ever stops matching, the checked-in data/cited slices remain the reference and the mismatch is reported, never silently accepted.

files.name: macula-greek-Nestle1904.tsv
files.what: Greek New Testament, Nestle 1904 text; lemma, Strong's, morphology, glosses, Louw-Nida domains

files.name: macula-hebrew.tsv
files.what: Hebrew Bible, Westminster Leningrad Codex (Hebrew versification); lemma, Strong's, morphology, glosses, Septuagint Greek equivalents

files.name: latVUC_vpl.zip
files.what: Clementine Vulgate 1598 (Vulgate versification: e.g. English Psalm 110 = Vulgate Psalm 109)

files.name: eng-kjv_vpl.zip
files.what: King James Version 1769; [brackets] mark words the translators supplied (printed in italics)
files.license: Public domain outside the UK (eBible.org eng-kjv)
